summary: The issuer, GCT Semiconductor Holding, Inc., filed an 8-K/A to include a legal opinion regarding the legality of shares of common stock issuable under an At Market Issuance Sales Agreement. The Sales Agreement, dated April 1, 2025, with B. Riley Securities, Inc. and H.C. Wainwright & Co., LLC, allows for up to $120,000,000 aggregate offering price of shares in an at-the-market offering. No specific terms such as price per share, premium, or timeline are stated. The filing is a routine registration compliance step with no special-situation or deal mechanics. This is a standard shelf takedown process, not a special situation.
